notes.subject: गुड़ी
notes.rationale: כליתי literally 'kidneys', interior self; rendered as 'गुड़ी' keeping the bodily organ, not abstract 'मन'

notes.subject: बुनलन
notes.rationale: תסכני literally 'entwine/screen over' — weaving picture kept as बुनना, not 'छुपाना'

notes.subject: यहवे के अंगीकार
notes.rationale: direct second-person address to Elohim throughout

notes.subject: हमरा
notes.rationale: object pronoun on תסכני supplied in Magahi though the Hebrew suffix already carries it

translation: काहे कि तूँ हमरा गुड़ी बनइलन; तूँ हमरा हमरा माय के पेट में बुनलन।
